principles: No continuous decorative motion; reduce-motion support; animations must never obscure critical readings; no false LIVE status.

behaviors.navigation: Crossfade outgoing 0→1 and translate incoming 12dp→0; keep bottom bar fixed; no whole-page zoom.
behaviors.cards: Fade alpha 0→1, translateY 8dp→0 on first appearance only, stagger 35ms maximum.
behaviors.metricUpdates: Crossfade numerical glyphs in place; use tabular figures; no counting animation that suggests measurements that were never received.
behaviors.gauge: Animate arc sweep from previous measured proportion to next over 700ms; avoid uncontrolled continuous rotation; arc does not imply heater control.
behaviors.sensorRows: Selected background/outline transition 180ms; offline state turns muted gray with timestamp.
behaviors.camera: Loading shimmer only while connecting, then fade into verified live video; show explicit disconnected state.
behaviors.chart: Line reveal on initial history load 420ms; thereafter update without restarting animation.
behaviors.alerts: Critical changes immediate, noncritical toast only if enabled; no repeated 5-minute interruptions.
behaviors.reducedMotion: Disable slides, pulses and sweep; immediate state change or <=100ms fade.
